# Fix pull request #36 (claude-sync: leave a checkout with .claude-sync-hold alone) in MossesX/axHub so it can reach main

The Dev Console's push banner tried to pull main in and it failed: the banner's Pull all stopped at a failed pull and handed this repo's pulls to this session.

- Repository: MossesX/axHub (the setup above makes a worktree of it, on branch `claude/claude-sync-hold`)
- Base branch: `main`
- Pull request: #36 https://github.com/MossesX/axHub/pull/36

What to do:
1. `git fetch origin`, then `git merge origin/main` into `claude/claude-sync-hold`.
2. Resolve every conflict keeping both sides' intent; when unsure which side wins, keep both and say so in the commit.
3. Run the repo's own fast checks for what you touched (its CLAUDE.md lists them).
4. Commit, then `git push origin HEAD:claude/claude-sync-hold`. CI runs again on the PR by itself.

Then finish the banner's Pull all: pull `main` into each of these branches too, one at a time:
- `claude/amberx-open-url`
- `go-pass`
For each: `git checkout -B <branch> origin/<branch>`, `git merge origin/main`, resolve, run the checks, `git push origin HEAD:<branch>`. If one can't be fixed, skip it, keep going, and list it at the end.

Rules:
- Push only to `claude/claude-sync-hold`. Never push to `main` or any other branch, never force-push, never merge the PR.
- Never print, copy or commit secrets (tokens, keys, .env files, .axf-console/).
- If a conflict needs a decision only Brett can make, stop and say exactly what and why in your final message.
- Record steps and the result on your change-log entry (the hooks do most of it).
- Pushes may also go to those branches (each only to itself); the base-branch and force rules hold for all of them.
- You can edit files and run git only; list any other command Brett should run at the end.
